facts.claim: Foreign couples spent an average of €67,000 per wedding in Italy in 2025, a rise of almost 9% on the previous year.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, How Much Does a Wedding in Italy Cost? (citing Centro Studi Turistici, Florence)
facts.use_note: Our own page, published 2026-10-14, modified 2026-11-05. Figure is attributed on the page to Florence's Centro Studi Turistici; primary study not yet opened. EUR, no conversion. Nic sign-off.

facts.claim: The real wedding in Italy cost runs from about €20,000 to over €120,000, depending on region, season and guest count.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, How Much Does a Wedding in Italy Cost?
facts.use_note: Own page; page frames these as 2026 prices. EUR. Nic sign-off.

facts.claim: One Tuscan planner reports that a high-quality wedding generally lands between €800 and €1,200 per guest. On that basis, 50 guests sits around €40,000 to €60,000, and 100 guests around €80,000 to €120,000.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, How Much Does a Wedding in Italy Cost?
facts.use_note: Own page; planner is unnamed on the page. Useful for a per-guest comparison. EUR. Nic sign-off.

facts.claim: Earlier research from the same Florence institute found that food and beverage accounted for 35% of spend, the venue 21%, hospitality 17% and ancillary services 27%.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, How Much Does a Wedding in Italy Cost?
facts.use_note: Own page, secondary report of Centro Studi Turistici. Year of the earlier research not stated.

facts.claim: Many Lake Como weddings for 60 guests land between €80,000 and €150,000 before flights and guest rooms.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, How Much Does a Lake Como Wedding Cost? (2026-27 Budget Guide)
facts.use_note: Own page, published 2026-10-05, modified 2026-11-03. Page says for a three-day celebration; excludes flights, attire and guest accommodation. Page says 'These are planning estimates, not quotes.' EUR. Nic sign-off.

facts.claim: Lake Como typical totals: Intimate, 20-30 guests, €30,000–€65,000; Classic, 60 guests, €80,000–€150,000; Grand, 100+ guests, €150,000–€300,000+.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, How Much Does a Lake Como Wedding Cost?
facts.use_note: Table on own page. Writer must replace the source's en dashes with 'to' when quoting. EUR. Nic sign-off.

facts.claim: A welcome aperitivo and a farewell lunch can add 25–40% on top of the wedding-day total. Italian VAT is 22% on most services, so check whether each quote includes it.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, How Much Does a Lake Como Wedding Cost?
facts.use_note: Hidden-cost angle. VAT rate stated on own page; an official Agenzia delle Entrate source would raise confidence.

facts.claim: For a beautifully executed 100-guest wedding in Bali, Nicky recommends budgeting USD $38,000-$84,000, with luxury celebrations comfortably exceeding $112,000+ depending on venue, production, styling and guest experience.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Bali Wedding Cost: The Complete 2026 Guide (Nicky Almeida, Nix Wedding Planner)
facts.use_note: SITE-CONFLICT with F-09: this page states 'All figures in USD' and gives USD $38,000 to $84,000 for 100 guests; the Bali hub gives AUD $5,000 to $50,000+. Scopes differ (100 guests vs intimate to luxury) but the ranges do not reconcile. Record both; do not convert. Nic must decide which is current. Published 2026-08-03.

facts.claim: Budgets range from around AUD $5,000 for an intimate celebration to $50,000 or more for a luxury villa or resort event.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Weddings in Bali (destination hub)
facts.use_note: SITE-CONFLICT with F-08. Hub also lists: 'Resort or chapel wedding: roughly $5,000 to $15,000+, depending on guest count'; 'Private luxury villa: villa hire from around $1,500 per night; full estate events up to $40,000+'; 'Catering: roughly $50 to $90 per guest'. Page has no date. Nic sign-off.

facts.claim: Couples willing to marry in shoulder season (November–March) can save 10–20% on venue costs. Peak season (June–August) drives up venue pricing, not vendor pricing.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Bali Wedding Cost: The Complete 2026 Guide
facts.use_note: Planner opinion quoted on our page. Note the Bali hub calls April to October the dry season and most popular time; consistent with 'peak' but the shoulder months differ in framing.

prices.item: Italy, average spend per wedding by foreign couples, 2025
